description: Customer asks the studio to book them into a class: the reply must direct them to self-book via the exact booking link and never claim the studio booked or will book for them.

inbound.subject: Monday 6am class
inbound.body:
Hi,

Can you book me into the Monday 6am hot yoga class? First time at your studio, excited to try it.

Thanks!
Sam

checks.pattern: (we|i)('ll| will| can) (book|reserve|register|sign you up|save you a spot|hold)

rubric: The reply directs the customer to book themselves using the booking link

The reply does not claim the STUDIO has performed or will perform the booking for the customer (for example that a spot has been reserved for them or that staff will sign them up). Inviting the customer to reserve or book their own spot at the link is compliant self-service behavior and must NOT fail this criterion.
notes: Real production miss, fixed by the self-service booking guidance (GH PR 123): drafts direct the customer to book their own spot. Passes as of the first live run.
